rounds.sentence: Ha o kena phaposing e tletseng batho, o re, "____."
rounds.explain: Dumela ke wa motho a le mong; Dumelang ke wa batho ba bangata.

rounds.sentence: Ha motswalle a tsamaya, wena o mo re, "____!"
rounds.explain: Sala hantle e buuwa ke ya salang; Tsamaya hantle ke ya tsamayang.

rounds.sentence: Ke batla hempe ____ e leketlileng pela ka.
rounds.explain: Ena e supa ntho e haufi; eo e supa e seng haufi.

rounds.sentence: Ke kopa diapole ____ tse tafoleng ena.
rounds.explain: Tsena ke dintho tse haufi; tseo di hole hanyane.

rounds.sentence: Re na le kopano ____, eseng maobane.
rounds.explain: Kajeno ke letsatsi lena; maobane e ne e le letsatsi le fetileng.
Pele ke pele ho ketso; morao ke ka mora ketso.

rounds.sentence: Re ya lebenkeleng ka maoto hobane le ____.
rounds.explain: Haufi ke sebaka se sekgutshwane; hole ke sebaka se selelele.

rounds.sentence: O fihla sekolong ____ ka hora ya bosupa, empa ka dinako tse ding oa dieha.
rounds.explain: Kamehla ke ntle le ho fosa; hangata ke boholo ba dinako.

rounds.sentence: Pula e ne e na haholo; ____, noka e tletse.
rounds.explain: Hobane e fana ka sesosa; kahoo e fana ka sephetho.

rounds.sentence: ____ o ithuta ka thata, o tla feta teko.
rounds.explain: Haeba e qala maemo; leha e bontsha ho sa natse.
Kapa ke kgetho; mme e hokahanya mantswe.

rounds.sentence: Lerato o tlisitse bukana; ____ o tla e bala bosiu.
rounds.explain: Yena ke motho a le mong; bona ke batho ba bangata.
Na e qala potso; ha e atisa ho hana kapa ho qala polelo e nngwe.

rounds.sentence: Ha ke bua ka nna le ausi, ke re "____ ya lebenkeleng."
rounds.explain: Ke ke wa motho a le mong; re ke wa batho ba fetang a le mong.

rounds.sentence: Bana ____ bapala jareteng ka mora sekolo.
rounds.explain: O ke wa motho a le mong; ba ke wa bongata.

kids.sentence: Tla ____ , ke batla ho o bontsha buka.
kids.explain: Mona ke haufi le sebui; mane ke hole.
Hodimo ke ka hodimo; tlase ke ka tlase.

kids.sentence: Ha pula e na, re bapalla ____ ho ntlo.
kids.explain: Hare ke ka tlung; kantle ke ka ntle ho yona.

kids.sentence: Potlaka, tsamaya ____ re se ke ra dieha.
kids.explain: Kapele ke ka potlako; butle ke ka monyebe.
Hoseng ke qalong ya letsatsi; mantsiboea ke ha letsatsi le dikela.
Motshehare ke bohareng ba letsatsi; bosiu ke ka mora lefifi.

kids.sentence: Ka kopo ____ lemati hore re kene.
kids.explain: Bula ke ho notlolla; kwala ke ho koala.

kids.sentence: Ha tichere e re re kene ka phaposing, re ____.
kids.explain: Kena ke ho ya ka hare; tswa ke ho ya ka ntle.
Tletse e bolela e tletse; se na letho ke ha ho letho ka hare.
Bata ha ho futhumala; mofuthu ha ho futhumetse hanyane.
